# Auth Me 在 Minecraft 中進行帳號驗證，並重新驗證您的遊戲會話 [![Build](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/axieum/authme/release.yml?branch=main&style=for-the-badge)][ci:release] [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/axieum/authme?style=for-the-badge&include_prereleases&sort=semver)][releases] [![Available For](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/versions/Available%20For_356643_latest.svg?badge_style=for_the_badge)][curseforge] [![Downloads](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/full_356643_downloads.svg?badge_style=for_the_badge)][curseforge:files]
Auth Me 是一款 **Minecraft 模組**，旨在將帳號驗證機制整合至遊戲中，以解決連線至伺服器時常見的會話驗證錯誤問題。 此為純**客戶端**模組，適用於 [Minecraft][minecraft] Java 版的當前主流版本。 #### 替代方案 - [ReAuth][reauth_mod]（作者：TechnicianLP） - [OAuth][oauth_mod]（作者：Sintinium） ## 贊助商 我們衷心感謝以下贊助商對 Auth Me 開發的支持。 [][bisecthosting] ## 參與貢獻 感謝您考慮為 Auth Me 做出貢獻！請參閱[貢獻指南][contributing]。 ## 安全漏洞 關於如何回報安全漏洞，請參閱[安全政策][security]。 ## 授權條款 Auth Me 是開源軟體，採用 [MIT 授權條款][licence] 發布。 [bisecthosting]: https://bisecthosting.com/axieum [ci:release]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/actions/workflows/release.yml [contributing]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md [curseforge]: https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/auth-me [curseforge:files]: https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/auth-me/files [fabric]: https://fabricmc.net/ [licence]: https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT [minecraft]: https://minecraft.net/ [oauth_mod]: https://github.com/Sintinium/oauth [reauth_mod]: https://github.com/TechnicianLP/ReAuth [releases]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/releases [security]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/security/policy
